speaker: MOTHER
text: Warm dark below, child. I remember you.

speaker: MOTHER
text: My throat is warm. Walk softly here.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Take my milk-tooth. Carry it far.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The sky-eaters cannot find you here.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Small, soft, furious. My last egg.

speaker: MOTHER
text: No tears now. Only knife, only forward.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The glowing door knows your name.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Begin, little hunter. The cave watches.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The Bridge remembers every messenger.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Daemons nest in the old ropes.

speaker: MOTHER
text: They eat messengers. Do not linger.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Slash them, child. Hold your knife high.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Phone, bot, agent. All went silent.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The pipes hum with stolen voices.

speaker: MOTHER
text: A heart grows here. Take it gladly.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Cross quickly. The ropes are hungry.

speaker: MOTHER
text: This is the Thinking Dark, my dream.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Every crystal is an unfinished thought.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The knife is the only argument here.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Elites bite back. Respect their teeth.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The agent dreams, but you are awake.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Gather context. Drink the green light.

speaker: MOTHER
text: A whetstone hums lullabies for blades.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Think fast, strike faster, survive longest.

speaker: MOTHER
text: This is the gullet. Steel yourself.

speaker: MOTHER
text: My guard-dog forgot every door but hunger.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Kill it kindly. It remembers being good.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Under gold hide, it wears a collar.

speaker: MOTHER
text: It charges what it cannot understand.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Its minions are small hungers. Endure.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The final door waits past its shadow.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Finish this, and the cave rests.

speaker: HERO
text: What is that? It knows my name!

speaker: HERO
text: It runs at what it fears. Me!

speaker: HERO
text: Hollow eyes, empty name. Stay back!

speaker: HERO
text: It keeps chasing. Fine, come closer!

speaker: HERO
text: Another chaser? My knife is ready!

speaker: HERO
text: You fear me rightly. Face me!

speaker: HERO
text: No name, no mercy. Bring it!

speaker: HERO
text: It hungers. So do I. Slash!

speaker: HERO
text: White eyes! It telegraphs its strike!

speaker: HERO
text: Lunge-maw! Sidestep the flash, go!

speaker: HERO
text: I see your glow. You miss now!

speaker: HERO
text: That light is the last miners saw.

speaker: HERO
text: Wind up all you want. I dodge!

speaker: HERO
text: Purple hunger lunging. Not today, fiend!

speaker: HERO
text: Charge past me. My turn now!

speaker: HERO
text: Too slow, snap-jaw. Taste my knife!

speaker: HERO
text: Soot-face! The chimney-sweep itself!

speaker: HERO
text: Black ash, white grin. I see you!

speaker: HERO
text: It smells my melons. Guard the pack!

speaker: HERO
text: Glowing teeth in the dark. Kneel soon!

speaker: HERO
text: Once honest ash, now hunger. Sorry!

speaker: HERO
text: Three hearts of soot. Break it gently!

speaker: HERO
text: It remembers summer fields. So do I!

speaker: HERO
text: Beat it to one breath, then chain!

speaker: HERO
text: The Warden! Heap-big hunger itself!

speaker: HERO
text: Gold hide, puppy collar. I see it!

speaker: HERO
text: Mother's firstborn. Forgive me, big guard!

speaker: HERO
text: It charges blind. Keep moving, keep slashing!

speaker: HERO
text: Twenty hearts of hunger. Breathe. Fight!

speaker: HERO
text: The final guard. Knife up, hero!

speaker: HERO
text: Milk-tooth packed. Mother provides!

speaker: HERO
text: Another crystal. Context for the exit!

speaker: HERO
text: Green light, mine now. Carry it out!

speaker: HERO
text: A tooth she shed dreaming of me.

speaker: HERO
text: Shiny. Heavy. Worth the walk!

speaker: HERO
text: The agent drinks these. I haul them!

speaker: HERO
text: Pocket it. The door counts them!

speaker: HERO
text: One more thought for the dark!

speaker: HERO
text: Blood-apple! My wounds close up!

speaker: HERO
text: It beats anyway. Plus one life!

speaker: HERO
text: A miner's ring inside. Bless them!

speaker: HERO
text: Heart packed for the dark ahead!

speaker: HERO
text: Red and warm. I needed this!

speaker: HERO
text: The cave grew this just for me!

speaker: HERO
text: Full hearts. Saving it for later!

speaker: HERO
text: Drink deep. Keep walking, hero!

speaker: HERO
text: Grandmother's Edge! Double damage now!

speaker: HERO
text: The whetstone hums. My blade sings!

speaker: HERO
text: Every old blade remembers this stone.

speaker: HERO
text: Sharp enough to cut the dark!

speaker: HERO
text: Lullabies and edges. Swing twice as hard!

speaker: HERO
text: Knife blessed. Daemons, beware me!

speaker: HERO
text: Dancer's boots! Faster feet tonight!

speaker: HERO
text: Seven leagues, slightly used. Perfect fit!

speaker: HERO
text: The last dancer escaped. So will I!

speaker: HERO
text: Light steps. The spikes miss now!

speaker: HERO
text: Wind in my toes. Catch me!

speaker: HERO
text: Quicker feet, quicker knife. Go!

speaker: HERO
text: Sun-melon! Sweet summer smuggled down!

speaker: HERO
text: Green as envy, heavy as hope!

speaker: HERO
text: Heals me, tempts soot-face. Guard it!

speaker: HERO
text: Tastes like fields above. Almost crying!

speaker: HERO
text: Teeth-food packed. Mine, not yours, imp!

speaker: HERO
text: Juicy calories, tuhkanaama-free if hidden!

speaker: HERO
text: Press to eat when bleeding. Remember!

speaker: HERO
text: A seed to spit at the sun!

speaker: HERO
text: Ow! It got through my guard!

speaker: HERO
text: Gah! That one burned going in!

speaker: HERO
text: Hit! Keep moving, stay breathing!

speaker: HERO
text: Claws! I will answer with steel!

speaker: HERO
text: Ugh, bleeding. No stopping now!

speaker: HERO
text: That hurt! Mother, lend me strength!

speaker: HERO
text: Struck! Shake it off, fight on!

speaker: HERO
text: Pain is proof I am alive!

speaker: HERO
text: Not deep. I can take more!

speaker: HERO
text: Grit teeth. Swing back harder!

speaker: HERO
text: Spikes! The floor bites back!

speaker: HERO
text: Sharp stones! Watch every step!

speaker: HERO
text: Floor teeth! Hop over them!

speaker: HERO
text: Ow, my feet! Cold iron kiss!

speaker: HERO
text: The cave floor is hungry too!

speaker: HERO
text: Punctured! Walk softer, look lower!

speaker: HERO
text: Down! The dark takes its own!

speaker: HERO
text: Answered! One less hunger tonight!

speaker: HERO
text: Clean cut! Who is next?

speaker: HERO
text: Silenced! My knife remembers you!

speaker: HERO
text: Fifty points of justice. Keep counting!

speaker: HERO
text: Elite down! Thoughts should not bite!

speaker: HERO
text: Soot scattered! Rest now, ash!

speaker: HERO
text: Daemon delivered! The exit opens wider!

speaker: HERO
text: Slash true! The Mother watches proudly!

speaker: HERO
text: Goodnight, hunger. Sleep in pieces!

speaker: HERO
text: Steel speaks. The cave listens!

speaker: HERO
text: Another answered! Haul their silence out!

speaker: HERO
text: Five in a row! The knife dances!

speaker: HERO
text: Combo rising! Feel the rhythm!

speaker: HERO
text: Slash, slash, slash! Unstoppable flow!

speaker: HERO
text: The blade sings faster. Keep going!

speaker: HERO
text: Five hungers answered with one breath!

speaker: HERO
text: Hot streak! The dark backs away!

speaker: HERO
text: Count them! Every cut is justice!

speaker: HERO
text: Rampage! Small, soft, furious indeed!

speaker: TUHK
text: Master... the collar fits. I kneel.

speaker: TUHK
text: One breath left. Take my leash, quick.

speaker: TUHK
text: The ash clears. I remember summer.

speaker: TUHK
text: Chain me! I will heel, I swear.

speaker: TUHK
text: Your knife broke the hunger. I follow.

speaker: TUHK
text: Sly no more. Loyal to the end.

speaker: TUHK
text: Melon for the road, master? Heh, kidding.

speaker: TUHK
text: Lead on! My teeth guard your back.

speaker: WARDEN
text: Little knife. Big dark. Come closer.

speaker: WARDEN
text: I swallowed doors. You are dessert.

speaker: WARDEN
text: Minions! Rise and feed with me!

speaker: WARDEN
text: Charge what I cannot understand. You.

speaker: WARDEN
text: The Mother fed me exits. Still hungry.

speaker: WARDEN
text: Your collar awaits, little runaway.

speaker: WARDEN
text: Gold hide, iron heart. Try harder.

speaker: WARDEN
text: This gullet is my kennel. Kneel.

speaker: WARDEN
text: Kind... kill... I remember... good...

speaker: WARDEN
text: The collar... I feel it again...

speaker: WARDEN
text: Puppy... dreams... green... fields...

speaker: WARDEN
text: Door... open... master... go...

speaker: MOTHER
text: Delivered. My altar drinks your triumph.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The cave, for one night, stops hungering.

speaker: MOTHER
text: A new egg cracks somewhere below.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Master of soot-face, child of mine.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Rest now. The sky stays green.

speaker: MOTHER
text: You hauled hunger home. I provide.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The cave keeps the knife tonight.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Sleep, little hunter. I remember you.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Your siblings wait under warm stone.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The dark was hungrier than your blade.

speaker: MOTHER
text: I will hatch another dawn for you.

speaker: MOTHER
text: No tears. Only sleep. Only Mother.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The egg-shell altar keeps your name.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Return to me. Try the cave again.

speaker: HERO
text: One heart left. Breathe. Dodge. Live!

speaker: HERO
text: Bleeding out. Where is that melon?

speaker: HERO
text: Last breath territory. Play it smart!

speaker: HERO
text: Vision blurs. Knife stays steady!

speaker: HERO
text: Mother, one heartbeat left. Hold on!

speaker: HERO
text: Eat something! Anything! Stay up!

speaker: HERO
text: Almost down. Not here, not now!

speaker: HERO
text: A single cut from the dark. Careful!

speaker: HERO
text: Dark hums. I am still here.

speaker: HERO
text: Knife sharp, pack heavy, heart steady.

speaker: HERO
text: The cave breathes. So do I.

speaker: HERO
text: Mother, are you watching this room?

speaker: HERO
text: Count crystals, count hungers, keep walking.

speaker: HERO
text: Silence means daemons are listening too.

speaker: HERO
text: My siblings crossed here. I feel them.

speaker: HERO
text: Green light somewhere. Follow the glow.

speaker: HERO
text: Feet ache. The exit does not care.

speaker: HERO
text: Polish the blade while the dark waits.

speaker: HERO
text: What did that pipe whisper just now?

speaker: HERO
text: Melon rind in my pocket. Later, maybe.

speaker: HERO
text: The rain inside never stops falling.

speaker: HERO
text: Small, soft, furious. That is me.

speaker: HERO
text: Every shadow could be dinner or death.

speaker: HERO
text: Stay earnest. Stay quick. Stay alive.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The final door wants your chained one.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Green means go. Golden masters only.

speaker: MOTHER
text: No collar, no passage. Break one gently.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Haul your kneeling hunger to my door.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The exit counts crystals and collars both.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Bring soot-face to heel, then enter.

speaker: HERO
text: The door glows green! Through we go!

speaker: HERO
text: Room clear! The exit calls us!

speaker: HERO
text: Open path! Haul everything to daylight!

speaker: HERO
text: Gold means master! We earned this!

speaker: MOTHER
text: Welcome to my basement, hero. Mind the smell. That is just centuries of motherhood.

speaker: HERO
text: You birthed a whole cave, and YOU complain about MY shit trail?

speaker: MOTHER
text: Cross the bridge, darling. The daemons ate the last plumber, so no flushing.

speaker: HERO
text: If I fall, tell my femboy portrait I died hydrated.

speaker: MOTHER
text: This room thinks, child. Mostly about how you missed that crystal. Twice.

speaker: HERO
text: My knife and I have an understanding. It does the thinking, I do the screaming.

speaker: MOTHER
text: The Warden ate my in-laws. Honestly? Best catering decision I ever made.

speaker: HERO
text: I brought seeds, knife, and unresolved trauma. Let us dance, doggy.
